notes: Inbound via enablement partner — demo signup converted to discovery call.
Company: ScoutScribe Solutions — small SaaS focused on call summaries for SDR teams.
Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) so they can integrate into their existing HubSpot workflows quickly.

PII concerns high: they process US sales calls with customer PII (emails, phone numbers, occasional SSNs in support calls). Asked 'how long do you keep audio/transcripts by default? can we auto-purge?'
Quote from CPO: 'We need guaranteed ability to purge records on request and a retention knob per-customer — default 30 days might be ok but must be configurable.'

Technical requirements: streaming summarization, speaker diarization OK-to-have, per-call redaction rules (emails, credit cards, SSN patterns), webhook delivery of sanitized summary, optional original transcript storage disabled by default.
Latency/throughput: SMB scale — 15-25 concurrent short calls (2-6 min). Want sub-5s first-chunk streaming summary for live agent notes.
Model preferences: willing to use a smaller open model for cost, but summarization quality must be high for sales coaching. Interested in Redwood's model catalog and quantization options.
Security: need audit logs and KMS integration for later stages. SSO not required for now — internal admin via email invites is fine for pilot.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — pilot budget limited, but if pilot proves ROI they will convert to paid plan.
Integration wishlist: HubSpot native save (custom object), real-time webhook to CRM, admin UI for retention settings per customer.
Follow-ups: sent hosted-api-quickstart.md + sample retention policy (drive link). Requested SE call to walk through redaction patterns and API keys rotation.
Stubs/refs: Fireflies call id ff-20260215-0a9f; Gmail thread thread-1792f3a4b with legal requesting retention examples; Drive: pricing + security FAQ shared.
AE notes: very responsive, wants fast PoC. Recommend 90-day pilot with token allotment and support from SE. Emphasize ability to disable transcript storage and enable redact-first pipeline.
Next: schedule 30m SE deep-dive (available Wed/Thu next week). Prepare simple demo showing live redaction + purge API.
